title.en: Self-hosted image hosting — one leap to a link

subtitle.zh: imgli 是 Go 单二进制多用户图床，内嵌 React。公共实例 img.li 供轻量试用（约 1GB 存储 / 5GB 月流量，非无限 CDN）；主路径是你自己部署。
subtitle.en: imgli is a single-binary multi-user image host in Go with embedded React. img.li is a limited public trial (~1GB storage / 5GB monthly bandwidth — not free CDN); the main path is self-hosting.

description.zh: 前端 go:embed 内嵌；默认 SQLite，可选 PostgreSQL；无 CGO 亦可运行。
description.en: Frontend embedded via go:embed; SQLite by default, PostgreSQL optional; CGO-free builds.

description.zh: 本地盘、S3 兼容、WebDAV；策略级 CDN 302 卸带宽，私密图预签名。
description.en: Local, S3-compatible, WebDAV; per-policy CDN 302 offload and presigned private serving.

description.zh: 可插拔机审（NSFW + OCR 词表）、审核队列、用户组策略。
description.en: Pluggable moderation (NSFW + OCR keywords), review queue, group policies.

description.zh: 干净上传 API + Token；PicGo / ShareX / uPic / CLI 开箱。
description.en: Clean upload API + tokens; PicGo / ShareX / uPic / CLI ready.

description.zh: Linux / macOS 用 install.sh 拉最新 Release。详见文档「安装」。
description.en: Linux / macOS: install.sh pulls the latest Release. See docs → Install.

description.zh: imgli serve 后打开本机端口；首位注册用户即管理员。见文档「配置」。
description.en: Run imgli serve; first registered user is admin. See docs → Configuration.

description.zh: 创建 API Token，用 PicGo 等上传。对接说明见文档。
description.en: Create an API token and upload via PicGo. See docs for integrations.

caption.zh: 完整安装、升级与配置见 docs.imgli.com；也可用 Docker：ghcr.io/yixian-huang/imgli:latest。
caption.en: Full install, upgrade, and config: docs.imgli.com. Docker: ghcr.io/yixian-huang/imgli:latest.

subtitle.zh: img.li 是限额公共实例（约 1GB / 5GB 月流）；安装与配置文档在 docs.imgli.com；代码在 GitHub（欢迎 Star）。
subtitle.en: img.li is a capped public instance (~1GB / 5GB monthly bandwidth); docs at docs.imgli.com; code on GitHub (stars welcome).
